title: Neko media slot
description: A frame for a photo or video that fills it like object-fit: cover; when empty it shows a plain token-coloured placeholder surface (muted, lemon wash, slate or ice).
notes: size, radius and position come from className; a passed img or video is stretched to cover the frame
name: neko-slot

props.name: media
props.description: the real image or video; leave empty for the placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder colour: muted grey, lemon wash, slate (dark enough for white text) or ice blue
